column60:
The SFM igneous province was originally dated at 1476 ± 16 Ma (U-Pb zircon;
Van Schmus et al., 1993), the age adopted by Meert & Stuckey (2002). A
subsequent U-Pb zircon and titanite study by du Bray et al. (2021) dated many
more SFM units and resolved two magmatic episodes: a more voluminous, widespread
episode at 1.48-1.45 Ga and a younger episode at 1.33-1.28 Ga. The dolerites and
acidic rocks carrying the paleomagnetic remanence belong to the older
1.48-1.45 Ga episode. Taking the spread of in-situ dates from that episode gives
a nominal age of 1466 Ma with bounds of 1448-1484 Ma, adopted here in place of
the older 1476 ± 16 Ma value.
